mixVerdict: DRAFT_MIX_FOR_REVIEW (v2, MEDIA-02 WO37 M-F CP2 palette re-mix): built with the exact v1 recipe (same composed stems, gain targets, ducking params, peak guard, loop joins); the ONLY change is the VO take -- Đội trưởng thợ lặn is now the M-F CP1 palette pickup (VO_CIN_015_S03_DIVERLEAD_palette_v1.wav; Husky Campfire (fictional system voice), avocado_v2:briggs) instead of the draft take voiced by avocado_v2:MAI_03. stemAssignment.source: No CP02 assignment exists for CIN_015; bach_uyen music + underwater ambience are the drowned-city cues (composed, CP26/CP30) for this scene (S01: wide view of the submerged ruined town, red-tiled roofs under water, stone arch and bubbles, WIDE_STATIC; S02: detail of the dining bowl tied to a stone table, guide rope and a bare diver hand, DETAIL_LOCKED; S03: top-down underwater corridor with a small diver figure in a conical hat at the bottom centre, TOPDOWN_MATCH; keyframes CIN_015 S01/S02/S03). bach_uyen is the composed set's underwater low-passed form (850 Hz) -- the setting-exact cue for a drowned city, for the line about a rope someone tied for the divers before ('Lan truoc co nguoi da buoc day nay cho chung ta.'). Its only previous mix use was the P0 v3 review reel; this is its first scene-mix use. underwater is the composed underwater bed for the submerged city framing all three shots; also first scene-mix use (P0 v3 review reel only before). ben_mua was passed over: just used for CIN_014, the immediately preceding scene. lam_trieu was passed over: the pastoral flute, used for CIN_013. tran_son ('Tran Son — Nguoi qua cua', the bell-led gate form) was passed over: already used for CIN_008 and CIN_012. quiet_discovery was passed over: used for CIN_007 and CIN_011. thang_long is the capital-city form (wrong setting); sa_hoa is desert/dry (wrong setting); rift_finale is the set's only full close (finale material, wrong for a mid-campaign chapter beat); boss_mang_cot is boss material. wind_canopy was passed over: just used for CIN_014; mountain_wind was used for CIN_013, forge for CIN_012, river_shore for CIN_003 and CIN_008 (water-edge, not submerged), waterfall for CIN_009; rain_light and rain_heavy are above-water rain; cave_drips is a cave bed, not an open drowned city; desert_wind, city_night, thang_long_crowd and rift are wrong for this setting. The reveal stinger is the scene's only manifest-listed candidate stem (CIN_015_timing_v1.json).
stemAssignment.alternateTakeExcluded: N/A: CIN_015 has no alternate take.

notes: M-F CP2 palette re-mix: the VO take(s) listed under paletteRemix.changes replace the v1 draft take(s). Any v1 note below describing the canonical take's duration or overrun describes the v1 mix only and does not apply to v2.
VO window 12.5-17.5 s is PROPOSED_ANIMATIC_PLACEMENT (only CIN_001_S05 is DECIDED); all 21 windows are approved for DRAFT VO per Goi 30 D1. The window is the uniform 12.5-17.5 s; it was NOT widened.

VO take runs 12.5-15.380 s: 2.880 s, ending 2.120 s BEFORE the 17.5 s window end -- the take FITS inside its window by 2120 ms (no overrun, unlike CIN_005/CIN_006). The take ends 2.620 s before the 18.00 s scene end, so no tail trim at the scene edge. The window, the take and the timing are unchanged.
The CP17 VO take measures -23.27 LUFS (checkpoint 17, re-verified from real bytes this run, vs -22.05 LUFS for the CIN_014 take). VO is kept at unity per the recipe, not normalized.

Staging: the timing manifest marks the S03 dialogue onscreen: true for the Diver Lead (NPC_DIVER_LEAD), and the S03 keyframe places a small diver figure with a conical hat at the bottom centre of a top-down underwater corridor -- the intended speaker position. But the figure is tiny and seen from above/behind, so the speaker is not identifiable by face or gear from the picture alone; S02 shows only a bare diver hand at the guide rope (no face) and S01 has no figure at all. That ambiguity is a final-picture/character-lock matter, not a mix defect; the mix does not move the VO.

Ducking depth is measured on the ducked bus against its unducked render (RMS over the full VO window vs a 2 s reference before the window). The full-window method from checkpoint 39 is retained so the depth is comparable across the CIN_003/CIN_005/CIN_007/CIN_008/ CIN_009/CIN_010/CIN_011/CIN_012/CIN_013/CIN_014/CIN_015 mixes (a 2 s slice can understate the cut on cues whose window opening is quiet).
Ambience loop join uses a 1 s acrossfade; loopQA reports the max sample jump at the join against the bed's own 99.9th-percentile jump.
Stinger placement at 6.0 s (S02 start) is PROPOSED pending picture lock, mirroring the CIN_004 reveal at 6.0 s.
